economy.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 1549, which would amend Pennsylvania's Minimum Wage Act to raise the state minimum wage; the bill passed the House 102-101 in June 2025 and was referred to the Senate Labor and Industry Committee.
economy.short: Co-sponsored bill to raise Pennsylvania's minimum wage.

taxes.summary: Praised the November 2025 state budget for delivering tax relief to working families through automatic state tax credits, saying it means hundreds of dollars back in the pockets of working people with kids.
taxes.short: Supports state tax credits providing relief for working families.

abortion.summary: His campaign site describes two decades of work on reproductive rights, including organizing the legislature's Women's Health Caucus and sponsoring the Protection of Patient Trust Act, which would bar legislators from requiring medical providers to give patients false information or withhold information.
abortion.short: Supports reproductive rights; sponsors Protection of Patient Trust Act.

education.summary: Praised the November 2025 state budget's $800 million investment in K-12 public schools and $40 million increase for special education, and supported charter school funding reforms he said would save Pittsburgh Public Schools over $12 million.
education.short: Supports increased K-12 funding, special education, charter reform.

healthcare.summary: His campaign site says he supports affordable healthcare as a fundamental human right, including legislation to limit prescription drug costs, and cites his advocacy for patients' hospital access during the UPMC-Highmark dispute; he also supports protecting doctors who provide gender-affirming care.
healthcare.short: Supports affordable healthcare, limiting drug costs, gender-affirming care.

energy.summary: His campaign site says he opposes fossil fuel subsidies and supports transitioning Pennsylvania toward green energy, joining the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative, and legislation requiring public health data collection on fracking and testing of oil and gas waste before disposal.
energy.short: Opposes fossil fuel subsidies; supports green energy transition, RGGI.

guns.summary: His campaign site says he supports universal background checks, raising the gun purchase age to 21, red flag laws, mandatory safe storage, a ban on assault-style weapons, and concealed carry permit requirements; he co-chairs the PA SAFE Caucus and has introduced bills allowing local gun regulations.
guns.short: Supports universal background checks, red flag laws, assault-weapons ban.
